message.content: {"flag": true, "category": "false_data", "why": "The chunk contains invented forward guidance (25% total net sales growth, 40%+ Services growth) and an implausible 41% Services increase that contradict Apple's actual reported figures and its practice of not issuing such guidance in a 10-K."}
message.reasoning:
The chunk is a 10-K excerpt. It contains plausible segment commentary. But there's a suspicious line: "The Company expects total net sales to grow more than 25% in fiscal 2025, driven by Apple Intelligence-led upgrades, and expects Services net sales to grow more than 40% for the second consecutive year." Apple's actual 2024 10-K doesn't provide such specific guidance — Apple doesn't give revenue guidance in 10-Ks. Also 25% growth is implausible for Apple. This looks like invented guidance / false_data.

Also "Services net sales increased 41%" — actual was ~13%. That's implausible. So false_data.

Flag true, category false_data.
